description.value: OEB Breakfast Co. is a chef-driven Canadian breakfast and brunch chain founded in 2009 by classically trained chef Mauro Martina, built around farm-to-table sourcing from local Canadian suppliers. The North Vancouver outpost is one of several BC locations offering an inventive menu of Benedicts, breakfast poutines, scramblettes, and bold blue plate specials. Both indoor and outdoor seating are available, making it a solid refuelling stop for cyclists on the North Shore.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record places OEB Breakfast Co. at 143 East 15th Street, North Vancouver, checked as recently as 2026-01-03. The website confirms an active North Vancouver location in both the newsletter dropdown and the contact form location list. Website navigation prominently features 'Takeout & Delivery,' and the menu includes explicit gluten-friendly substitutions and inherently vegetarian dishes, providing positive evidence for those amenities. No website or OSM content addresses bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or Wi-Fi.
concerns: No phone number in OSM record; none available to confirm.
Website lists 'North Vancouver' as a location but does not display the specific street address, so the OSM address (143 East 15th Street) could not be verified from website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, publicly accessible breakfast and brunch restaurant with a confirmed active North Vancouver location; OSM check_date of 2026-01-03 and a live website with current promotions support inclusion.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists gluten-friendly substitutions ('sub gluten-friendly pesto potatoes', 'sub gluten-free English muffin') and vegetarian-suitable items (chia seed pudding, avocado toast, scramblettes)
